# [TASK] Build media attachment uploaders and thumbnail galleries for movie reviews

## Task
Add file attachment capabilities to movie review submission forms in the React frontend, allowing users to upload screenshot proofs or short clips and rendering interactive thumbnail galleries on movie detail pages.

## Parent Story
Parent: #115

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Review comment form includes an attachment uploader supporting image and short video files
- [x] Media assets upload via `POST /api/v1/media/upload` with `entityType=MOVIE_REVIEW` and `entityId` linking the movie/review
- [x] Movie details page retrieves associated review media via `GET /api/v1/media/entity/{entityId}` and renders clickable thumbnail galleries
- [x] Unit/DOM tests verify attachment uploads and gallery rendering

## Estimate
Hours: 12

## Notes
• Verified via ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx and MovieInformation.test.jsx.
